title: Masking works by disrupting recurrent processing

statements.text: Backward masking derives its effect, at least in part, from interrupting recurrent processing while leaving the feedforward sweep intact. Activity before about 110 ms is unconscious, while posterior activity after 110 ms is at least a necessary condition for awareness.
